name: 王秋玄
objective:
本課程旨在培養學生之創意發想、設計思維與實作能力。透過專題導向的設計流程，引導學生從觀察、問題探索、概念發展、原型製作至作品實現，理解使用者、媒材、互動與情境之間的關係。學生將運用多元媒材與互動形式進行創作，並透過反覆測試與修正，培養概念表達、跨域整合、問題解決與設計實踐能力，最終完成具創意與完整體驗之設計作品。
This course focuses on developing students’ creative ideation, design thinking, and hands-on implementation skills through project-based learning. Students will be guided through a complete design process, including observation, problem exploration, concept development, prototyping, implementation, and iterative refinement. The course emphasizes the relationships among users, media, interaction, and context, and encourages students to explore different forms of creation using 2D and 3D media, digital media, and interactive technologies. Through iterative design, testing, and refinement, students will strengthen their abilities in concept communication, interdisciplinary integration, problem solving, and project development.

name: 黃儀婷
objective:

This course aims to develop the ability of students to meet specific sensory needs through the creation of abstract visual order in the form of two-dimension and three-dimension. The visual organization of design elements including line, plane, volume, and the analysis of their abstract relationships and principles of order are studied.

name: 蔡欣蓓
objective:
本課程以建立設計思維與表現能力為目標。課程面向包括：建立美感、創意發想、應用媒材、跨域整合、傳達概念、分析批判。透過平面及立體的構成練習以及造形與色彩的研究，傳授基礎設計原理，訓練學生計畫性創造能力，並透過專題實作熟練設計技巧與流程。
This course aims to develop students’ design thinking and expressive abilities. The course covers areas including aesthetic development, creative ideation, media application, interdisciplinary integration, concept communication, and critical analysis. Through 2D and 3D composition exercises, as well as studies of form and color, students learn the fundamental principles of design. The course also trains students in systematic creative thinking and enables them to become familiar with design techniques and processes through project-based practice.
